int2tf32(-1) = 0x5fc00
tf322int(0x3fc00) = 2147483647
double2tf32(-0.000000) = 0x40000
tf322double(0x20400) = 4.000000 (0x4010000000000000)
tf32_add(0x3fc00, 0x20400) = 0x3fc00
tf32_mul(0x20400, 0x60400) = 0x60c00
tf32_div(0x20400, 0x20400) = 0x1fc00 (1.000000)
tf32_compare(0x3fc00, 0x7ffff) = -2
put_tf32(0xffffffff) is 1111111111111111111
